name: core-description-vlm-v0.8-single-column

training_data.source_pair_approval: The user approved the original photo-description pairs for training.
training_data.crop_review_status: Automatically produced depth crops and repeated first-sentence tile labels have not been checked by a geologist. Their manifest training_approved flag is false; the v8 run was an explicitly authorized experimental candidate run.

training_metrics.note: Training loss is not geological accuracy.

heldout_evaluation.method: One representative tile per held-out source row, same prompt and deterministic decoding for base, v7, and v8. Russian rock/color keyword overlap with source first sentence; not expert accuracy.

limitations: Only one well; the held-out blocks do not measure generalization to other wells or depositional environments.
The 19 held-out descriptions are dominated by sandstone, so class balance is poor.
Some full-layer labels may not describe every narrow photo tile; linear depth alignment also requires visual confirmation.
Visible color can differ from the report because of lighting and photo processing.
Some outputs include invented lithology, structures, and depth. Manual review is required.
No validated facies classification or YOLO segmentation is supplied by this adapter.
